Profil sismique réflexion le long d\\'un: Seismic reflection profile along a transect between two selected blocks (A→B). Reveals the geometry of the reflectors (stratiform horizons) and discontinuities (faults). Vertical resolution ±150-250 m.
Profondeur des horizons sur tout le prof: Depth of the horizons along the whole A→B profile, major faults, trap geometry
Cube sismique 3D avec analyse AVO (Ampli: 3D seismic cube with AVO (Amplitude Versus Offset) analysis: looks for amplitude anomalies (bright spots, flat spots) that betray a possible presence of fluids. It is the best information available WITHOUT drilling, but an amplitude anomaly is not proof: a water-bearing sand, a particular lithology or a very low gas saturation can give a false bright spot, and a real field can stay discreet. The displayed uncertainty does not cover this false-signal risk. It does not replace a well log, which requires a real hole.
Profondeur précise du réservoir, probabi: Precise reservoir depth, probability and quality narrowed through direct indicators
Carottage et analyses laboratoire : lame: Coring and laboratory analyses: thin sections (petrography), mercury porosimetry (MICP), permeameter, extract chromatography. Provides the true reservoir properties. Requires a physical rock sample: only possible on a block already drilled.
